title: Strategy accounting and consensus correctness with operational locks preserved
approved_by: Luciano Leal — explicit instruction in current conversation
objective: Implement per-module closed-trade accounting and conservative signal aggregation, fix inconsistent module weights and rejected-score propagation; test only synthetic fixtures.
rationale: User explicitly authorized implementing the proposed strategy improvements using available demo resources. Current connectors expose market data only, not demo balances; no balance or demo ledger is available. This SPEC records code implementation authorization, not execution or independent certification.
scope_in: Canonical registry for the nine existing engine modules
Descriptive accounting of explicitly attributed closed trades; strict provenance and costs
Review-only weight assessment without win-rate-based auto-increases
Propagate score rejection into risk decisions
Synthetic engineering tests and PR update
scope_out: Account access, credential reads, demo/live orders, holdout access
Automatic promotion or empirical strategy profitability claims
Changes to frozen baseline, protections, historical evidence or hypothesis ledgers

acceptance_criteria.description: Nine module identities and weights match emitted signals
Duplicates, conflicts, absent evidence and rejected scores cannot manufacture approval
High win rate with net loss cannot increase weights; costs and attribution are explicit
Unknown demo balance remains unknown and operational controls remain unchanged
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Preservation check and no account claim in report

notes: APPROVED means implementation scope authorized by the current user request only. No operational or independent acceptance grant.
